frameworks.structure: 4 aspects x 3 progression levels (Understand / Apply / Create) = 12 competency blocks, 36 curricular goals. Code scheme CG4.[level].[aspect].[n]; level 1=Understand 2=Apply 3=Create; aspect 1=Human-centred mindset 2=Ethics of AI 3=AI techniques & applications 4=AI system design.

blocks.name: Citizenship in the era of AI

frameworks.doctrineNote: This taxonomy teaches students to DIRECT AI, not build it. Aspect-4 mappings are therefore deliberately sparse and concentrate on problem scoping (CG4.1.4.x) — including CG4.1.4.1, when AI should NOT be used.
